title: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young half-fae hero who conjures a blade of light from his hilts, collapses from cold, and learns that Talion helped create the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: Kellan's red-cloaked friend who carries him through the blizzard to Hylda's castle, refusing to abandon him.

entities.name: Peter
entities.description: Ruby's brother, a hunter who lends them cloaks and escorts them most of the way to Loch Larent.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: A lonely witch who rules a castle of ice at Loch Larent, tests Kellan and Ruby, then gives up her crown and reveals Talion's role in the Slumber.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: The Faerie Lord who set Kellan's quest and whom Hylda says broke a stalemate by proposing Eriette's sleeping curse to stop the invaders.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch whose sleeping curse became the Wicked Slumber; Hylda says its spiraling out of control is her doing.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: A witch whom Kellan and Ruby threw into a cauldron.

entities.name: Imodane
entities.description: A knight who once tried to cross Hylda's drawbridge before coming to Edgewall.

entities.name: Troyan
entities.description: The guide whose talk of places like a pain circus Ruby calls made up.

entities.name: Frost warriors
entities.description: Ice warriors conjured from the swirling snow by Hylda to drive off Kellan and Ruby.

entities.name: The Wicked Slumber
entities.description: The sleeping curse spreading across Eldraine and into Edgewall.

entities.name: Basket hilts
entities.description: Kellan's fae-wrought hilts that finally form a sword of light.

entities.name: Hylda's crown
entities.description: The crown of Winter that lets Hylda maintain her ice castle, given up as proof of her defeat.

entities.name: Loch Larent
entities.description: A frozen loch and its sprawling ice castle that begins to melt once Hylda gives up her crown.

entities.name: Edgewall
entities.description: The town where Kellan and Ruby return and find the Slumber's violet threads everywhere.

entities.name: Orrinshire
entities.description: Kellan's home village, whose strong wool saves him from the frost warrior.

entities.name: Castle Ardenvale
entities.description: The castle where Talion says Eriette will be found.

entities.name: Talion's court
entities.description: The false-castled fae realm reached by a portal.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders the witches and Talion cast the Slumber against.

events.summary: Kellan and Ruby return to Edgewall to find the Slumber's violet threads spreading across the town.
events.quote: Now, with a sinking heart, Kellan realizes that the victims are beyond counting.

events.summary: Peter agrees to take them to Loch Larent, warning them to turn back if they cannot feel their noses, and Ruby promises.
events.quote: "You must wear my thickest cloak, and when you can no longer feel your nose, you must turn back.

events.summary: Peter shows them a puppet show of a girl in a red hood defeating a witch, moving Ruby.
events.quote: All watch in perfect stillness as two puppets triumph over all manner of trouble to defeat an evil, man-eating witch.

events.summary: Peter leaves them to camp as Kellan and Ruby approach Hylda's ice castle at Loch Larent.
Hylda's voice warns them to turn back and summons frost warriors, one pinning Kellan's cloak and another seizing Ruby.
events.quote: Another warrior's formed, and this one's got her in its clutches.

events.summary: Kellan pleads to his father and his hilts become a blade of light that cuts down the warriors' arms; he frees Ruby.
events.quote: his newfound sword cuts straight through the frost warrior's arm.

events.summary: Kellan collapses from the cold and sleepiness, and Ruby catches him.
Ruby carries Kellan toward the castle over Hylda's taunts, then crawls across the drawbridge past frozen bodies, refusing to abandon him.
events.quote: She shifts Kellan onto her back, throws her hands out ahead.

events.summary: Hylda appears kneeling beside Ruby and Kellan, extends a hand, clears the weather, and puts them to sleep to keep them safe.
They wake in the ice castle where Hylda hands over her crown as proof of defeat, and the castle begins to melt.
events.quote: "Take that to the Kindly Lord, as proof of my defeat."

events.summary: Hylda reveals the witches did not create the Slumber alone and that Talion proposed Eriette's sleeping curse for a boon.
events.quote: Talion was the one who broke the stalemate.

events.summary: Kellan storms out and goes through Talion's portal with Ruby to confront him, throwing the crown at his feet.
events.quote: Kellan throws the crown at Talion's feet.

events.summary: Talion defends himself, says fae do not lie, and tells Kellan to defeat Eriette at Castle Ardenvale to learn of his father.
events.quote: "You shall find Eriette at Castle Ardenvale.

events.summary: Back outside Hylda's castle Kellan weeps.

relations.quote: Peter's the hero in our family.

relations.note: She carries him through the blizzard
relations.quote: "People don't need to owe each other to help each other,"

relations.note: Kellan serves the Kindly Lord on a quest, though he feels betrayed
relations.quote: My lord said that whoever defeats the witches will end the curse

relations.note: Hylda says Agatha deserved being thrown in a cauldron
Talion proposed the sleeping curse and helped cast it with the witches
relations.quote: Eriette's sleeping curse, they argued, would be the surest way to counteract the invaders.

relations.note: Hylda joined Talion in the casting for a boon
relations.quote: Thus, they offered us the chance to save the Realm—and boons for our help.

relations.note: Hylda blames Eriette for the curse spiraling
relations.quote: That it continued spiraling out of control afterward is Eriette's doing.
Her brother drapes a bearskin around her shoulders
Without the crown I can maintain only a small home for me and mine.

relations.note: Loch Larent lies a long week journey from Edgewall
relations.quote: Loch Larent lies a long week's journey from Edgewall.
